RESULT [selftrain]: About 24% higher mAP than fully fine-tuned YOLO models on agricultural datasets, including plant-weed detection, and about 10% better than the previous state of the art on few-shot remote sensing.
US [selftrain]: Species names such as 'Eclipta' or 'Cutleaf Groundcherry' are weak text prompts for OWLv2 or Grounding DINO.
